nodes.text: You are here for the stone. They sent a topsider, because they do not come and they do not ask. I have a schedule.

choices.text: The Charter's price for two stones.
They are asking. In words. Through me.

nodes.text: Forty coins. Two stones off the load, under Charter paper, and the entry says sold. Where it came from is a field. Where it goes is a road. You do the middle.
Forty on the counter when you have it, and two come off the load under Charter paper. Until then they ride the wain. I have a schedule.
Then the load goes to the dike. It was going there.
Asked. Written down. Two off the load, and the column says asked, which it has not said before. It says it once.
The column says asked. It does not say twice. I have a schedule.
